item.description: • Automatic updates: Idle Town Center now downloads updates in the background and installs them the next time it quits. You can turn this off in Settings › Updates.

• Warning for older Recordings: watching a Recording made on an older build of Age of Empires II now asks first, because the Game can only replay its own version exactly and older Recordings tend to go out of sync. You can turn the warning off.
  • Better out-of-sync diagnostics: anonymous usage data now includes the Game and Recording builds and notes when playback stops unexpectedly, so sync problems can be tracked down. No player names or file names are sent, and you can still turn this off in Settings.

First public release.

  • Watch Recordings with a live overlay: each player's resources, villagers, army, idle villagers and idle Town Center time, plus a score table.
  • Timeline: jump to any minute, change speed, switch whose view you watch.
  • Recordings: every match in one list, searchable by player, civ and map, with villager graphs.
  • Friends: follow players and download and watch their recent ranked matches.
  • Leaderboard: the Mac ranked ladder, with stats and recent matches for any player.

Requires Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition (the Mac version on Steam). Recordings made on an older Game build may go out of sync.
